## Research brief: will Hegseth, Patel or RFK Jr. be out within 90 days (as of 2026-09-16)?

### 1. Resolution source
- The question has no URL or fine print. It "resolves according to the question text," which means an actual exit from office by any of the three: Pete Hegseth (Defense/War Secretary), Kash Patel (FBI Director) or Robert F. Kennedy Jr. (HHS Secretary).
- The question appears to come from a Manifold series by user TheWabiSabi. Several versions exist ([1](https://manifold.markets/TheWabiSabi/hegseth-patel-or-rfk-is-out-within-6ShZILSE0z), [2](https://manifold.markets/TheWabiSabi/hegseth-patel-or-rfk-is-out-within-uQcPLPOhqI), [3](https://manifold.markets/TheWabiSabi/hegseth-patel-or-rfk-is-out-within-LRUCtl0Rhg)). I could not load these pages because the proxy refused the connection. A search snippet suggests a version counts only someone who "officially vacates or ceases to hold" office, not an announced departure.
- The deadline is unclear. "Within the next 90 days" doesn't match the stated resolution date of about 2026-10-05, which is only 19 days after the forecast closes. The forecaster should check which window applies.

### 2. Current status
- As of 2026-09-16, all three are still in office. I found no announced resignation, firing or named successor for any of them.
- 2026-09-15: Patel testified for about five hours at a Senate Judiciary oversight hearing, which shows he was still serving. [CNN](https://www.cnn.com/2026/09/15/politics/live-news/kash-patel-hearing-senate), [WaPo](https://www.washingtonpost.com/national-security/2026/09/15/senators-grill-fbi-director-kash-patel/)
- 2026-09-15: Hegseth met Germany's defense minister, according to a War Department readout. [war.gov](https://www.war.gov/News/Releases/Tag/296734/hegseth/)

### 3. Recent news (newest first)
- 2026-09-15: At the hearing, Patel was pressed on looser FBI hiring standards, his firing of experienced agents, and whether agents would be sent to polling places. He gave a commitment that the FBI would not seize ballots. Afterward he attacked Democrats publicly. [MPR/NPR](https://www.mprnews.org/story/2026/09/15/fbi-chief-kash-patel-defends-loosening-of-employment-standards-on-bestiality-prostitution), [NBC](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/justice-department/fbi-director-kash-patel-clashes-democrats-oversight-hearing-rcna597915), [The Hill](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/6092298-fbi-kash-patel-defense-senate-hearing-democrats/)
- 2026-09-02: Republican Sen. Thom Tillis publicly urged Trump to replace Hegseth, calling him incompetent. Rep. Don Bacon agreed. The White House said Trump has "complete trust" in Hegseth. [TIME](https://time.com/article/2026/09/02/trump-hegseth-tillis-driscoll-resignation-pentagon/), [Fox](https://www.foxnews.com/politics/gop-sen-thom-tillis-urges-trump-replace-pete-hegseth-blasts-pentagon-leadership)
- 2026-08-31: Army Secretary Dan Driscoll resigned after months of clashes with Hegseth over promotions and the April firing of Army Chief Gen. Randy George. Navy Secretary John Phelan had reportedly also clashed with Hegseth and left. The same day, Trump said Hegseth was doing a "fantastic job." [NPR](https://npr.org/2026/09/01/g-s1-141337/army-secretary-stepping-down)
- August 2026: Kennedy announced a childhood vaccine schedule overhaul from the Oval Office, a sign of continued White House backing. I found no new wave of calls for him to resign in August or September 2026. [Axios](https://www.axios.com/2026/10/26/rfk-midterms-hhs-future)
- April 2026: An Atlantic report alleged heavy drinking and absences by Patel, and Sen. Dick Durbin called for him to be replaced. Patel sued The Atlantic for $250M, and The Atlantic moved to dismiss in July. [Kalshi News](https://news.kalshi.com/p/patel-lawsuit-exit-odds-surge), [Wikipedia](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kash_Patel)

### 4. Base rates
- Trump's second term has had heavy cabinet-level turnover in 2026:
  - Kristi Noem was removed in early March.
  - Pam Bondi was ousted on 2026-04-02.
  - Labor Secretary Lori Chavez-DeRemer was fired in April.
  - Tulsi Gabbard resigned. [CSMonitor](https://www.csmonitor.com/USA/Politics/2026/0402/pam-bondi-fired-epstein?icid=rss), [CT Public/NPR](https://www.ctpublic.org/2026-04-21/what-the-sudden-turnover-in-trumps-cabinet-means-for-him-politically), [AOL list](https://www.aol.com/articles/bondi-noem-replaced-running-list-230238764.html)
- That is roughly 4 cabinet-level exits in about 20 months. Hegseth, Patel and Kennedy have each survived intense pressure: Hegseth in the 2025 Signal chat episode, Patel after the April 2026 Atlantic story, and Kennedy after more than 1,000 HHS staff called for him to resign in 2025. [Axios 2025](https://www.axios.com/2025/04/21/pete-hegseth-trump-signal), [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/rfk-jr-hhs-cdc-robert-kennedy-resign-2123789)
- Trump has tended to make firings in clusters, and so far none of these three has been among them.

### 5. Other forecasts
- 2026-09-07 (Polymarket snapshot): Patel out by September 30: 6%. Patel out by December 31: 22%. This is down from about 80% in April 2026. [DeFi Rate](https://defirate.com/news/will-trump-fire-kash-patel-odds-signal-growing-exit-risk/), [Prediction Hunt](https://www.predictionhunt.com/news/why-kash-patel-s-80-exit-odds-are-probably-right-apr-20-2026)
- 2026-08-13 (Polymarket snapshot): RFK Jr. out by December 31: about 32%, on thin volume of about $24K. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/rfk-jr-out-by-december-31-524)
- Early September 2026: Newsweek cited Kalshi at about 9% for Hegseth's exit, but I could not confirm the date or deadline of that contract. [Newsweek](https://www.newsweek.com/pete-hegseth-chances-army-firing-dan-driscoll-secretary-12396919)
- I found no Hegseth December 31 Polymarket price dated on or before 2026-09-16. [Polymarket](https://polymarket.com/event/pete-hegseth-out-as-secretary-of-defense-by-december-31)
- I could not read the Manifold price for this exact question as of the forecast date.

### 6. Upcoming events before resolution
- 2026-09-30: The federal fiscal year ends, with possible funding or shutdown fights.
- 2026-11-03: Midterm elections. This falls inside a 90-day window but after the 2026-10-05 resolution date. Speculation about a post-midterm shake-up mostly comes from unreliable sources. [military-stuff.org](https://www.military-stuff.org/hegseth-out-after-the-midterms-trump-ready-to-give-him-rumsfeld-treatment/)
- Ongoing risks:
  - Hegseth: more friction with service secretaries, and Republican senators such as Tillis criticizing him.
  - Patel: the Atlantic lawsuit and election-related FBI controversies.
  - Kennedy: vaccine policy fights. HHS opened a public comment process on wireless radiation on 2026-09-17.
- Hegseth has a planned "State of the Force" address to troops at Quantico. It was not yet announced as of 2026-09-16, as far as I found.
